Take {{Green|-20%}} Damage from {{mt|animal}} mobs.
Gain {{Stat|combat wisdom|+45}} against {{mt|Animal}} mobs. |attack_speed=5% |item_ability_description=Deal {{Stat|damage|+100%}} against wolves when wearing a full set of {{Coll|Armor of the Pack}} or {{Coll|Mastiff Armor}} |item_ability_name=Pack Mentality }} The '''Pooch Sword''' deals {{Stat|dmg|+20}} per {{CollectionLink|Wolf Slayer}} level, alongside granting {{Stat|dmg|+200%}} against wolves and {{Stat|combat wisdom|+45}} against {{mt|Animal}} mobs.
